'''Armored sneak suits''' were combat outfits worn by [[Justice Action Network]] [[operative]]s. The suits provided some protection against both physical and energy attacks, and also made the wearer harder to spot.<ref name="ES">{{WEGCite|story=The Event of the Season|book=Tapani Sector Instant Adventures}}</ref>
